parts.html: The K-45 kitchen is a modern minimalist U-shaped model designed for spacious kitchens, open-plan kitchen and living areas, and other open living spaces. The composition combines light beige fronts, tall wood-look columns in a light walnut finish, and a striking dark work area with a stone countertop and backsplash. This makes the kitchen feel warm, sleek, and upscale all at once.

The model’s main design accent is the contrast between the soft, light cabinetry and the rich, dark work surface. The upper and lower fronts come in a calm beige shade that creates a neutral backdrop for the interior. On the left are tall units in a wood decor reminiscent of light walnut. They add depth to the composition and make the kitchen feel cozier. One of the units features an open niche that lightens the mass of the wooden block and can be used for decor or practical storage.

The work area features a stone countertop and backsplash in the same dark decor with striking light and warm veining. This finish unites the horizontal and vertical surfaces in a cohesive composition and emphasizes the kitchen’s contemporary character. The stone surface gives the model a more premium look and pairs well with both the light fronts and the wood elements.
Layout and dimensions

The K-45 has a U-shaped configuration, with cabinetry and work surfaces arranged along three sides. This layout makes it easy to organize storage, built-in appliances, the sink, the cooking area, and an extra countertop for everyday use.
The total length of the kitchen is 8 linear meters; the standard overall dimensions are 8 × 2.3 × 0.9 m.

One side of the kitchen extends into a peninsula with a breakfast bar, which counts as the island in the model’s specifications. The interior visualization shows two bar seats, so the model is well suited not only for cooking but also for quick breakfasts, socializing, and using the space as part of an open-plan kitchen and living area.
Front and carcass materials
The upper and lower fronts of the K-45 kitchen are foil-wrapped. This solution achieves a smooth, modern surface and neat geometry in keeping with the minimalist style.
The carcass is made of 18 mm thick laminated chipboard.

Visually, the main fronts are finished in a warm light beige, while the tall columns feature a wood decor. This combination makes the model versatile and suitable for modern, minimalist, and soft contemporary interiors.
Hardware and functionality
The standard K-45 configuration includes the AVENTOS HF lift-up mechanism, which is used for the upper fronts and makes the wall cabinets easy to open.
Hinged elements are fitted with Hettich hinges with a soft-close mechanism.
Drawers run on the Atira Hettich system.
A cargo pull-out is included in the standard configuration, making it more convenient to store bottles, jars, spices, and other kitchen essentials.
Handles are also included, although the visual concept features sleek dark profile lines that emphasize the minimalist geometry of the fronts.
Built-in appliances

The K-45 is designed for built-in appliances. In the visualization, the built-in units are housed in the tall wood-finish block, which keeps the composition of the fronts clean and makes the appliances more convenient to use.
Depending on the project, the placement of the oven, microwave, refrigerator, cooktop, sink, and other appliances can be adapted to the room dimensions and to the way you usually use your kitchen.
Island section and breakfast bar

An important feature of the model is the island/peninsula element, which extends the work surface and forms a breakfast bar. This makes the kitchen more functional in everyday use and allows it to serve as a space for socializing, quick meals, and serving food.
The dark stone countertop continues onto this element, visually tying the whole kitchen together into a single composition.
Additional options
At the client’s request, the K-45 kitchen can be equipped with more functional cabinet hardware, additional storage systems, and alternative opening mechanisms.

The kitchen can also be made from alternative materials, ranging from more budget-friendly to premium. The front materials, interior fittings, hardware level, cabinet configuration, and individual decorative solutions can all be changed.
These items are additional options and are not part of the base standard K-45 configuration.
K-45 kitchen technical specifications
Color: Beige
Style: Minimalist
Layout: U-shaped
Countertop type: Stone
Overall dimensions: 8 × 2.3 × 0.9 m
Length: 8 linear m
Lift-up mechanism: AVENTOS HF
Appliance installation type: Built-in
Cargo pull-out: Yes
Handles: Included
Upper front type: Foil-wrapped
Lower cabinet fronts: Foil-wrapped
Carcass type: Laminated chipboard, 18 mm
Island: Yes, as a peninsula with a breakfast bar
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism
Drawer system type: Atira Hettich
Decor: Solid-color in the base specification, with wood and stone accents in the visual concept
Additional features shown in the visualization: tall wood-finish columns, an open niche, dark stone backsplash, dark stone countertop, a breakfast bar for two, and built-in appliances.
Custom K-45 kitchen in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers design, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation of custom kitchens in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-45 model can serve as a standard model that is then adapted to a specific room. The dimensions, appliance placement, peninsula configuration, interior fittings, and combination of materials can all be changed.
